document.name: Riverdale Neighborhood House — Summer Camp 2026
document.shortDescription: Riverdale Neighborhood House runs a weekday Bronx summer camp for ages 4-11 with daily swim lessons, sports, crafts, STEM activities, and optional extended day.
document.longDescription:
Riverdale Neighborhood House publishes a Summer Camp program at 5521 Mosholu Avenue in the Riverdale section of the Bronx. The official page says the camp is open to children entering Pre-K through 5th grade, listed as ages 4-11, and describes an action-packed program with swimming, sports, performing arts, chess, crafts, outdoor adventures, themed days, and more.

The same official page lists regular camp hours of 9am-3pm and says early morning drop-off and extended day are available from 8am-5pm for an additional fee. Camp runs Monday, June 22, 2026 through Friday, August 21, 2026, and families can sign up for a minimum of two weeks or the whole summer. The camp experience section specifically highlights daily swim lessons with certified instructors plus sports, crafts, STEM, arts, and daily snacks, with lunch available for an additional fee.

Published pricing on the page is week-based rather than per class: 2 weeks cost $700 with the early-bird discount or $750 after April 1, and 8-9 weeks cost $600 early bird or $665 after April 1. The same page lists lunch at $40/week, early drop-off at $10/day, late pickup at $20/day, limited financial aid availability, and contact details of rnhsummercamp@riverdaleonline.org and (718) 549-8100 ext.116.

Sources: https://www.riverdaleonline.org/camp/
